question: Pipe A and pipe B running together can fill a cistern in 6 minutes. If B takes 5 minutes more than A to fill it, then the time in which A and B will fill that cistern separately will be, respectively, __________ .
solution:
Given:

Pipe A and pipe B running together can fill a cistern in 6 minutes.

B takes 5 minutes more than A to fill it. 

 

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let Pipe A takes x minutes

So pipe B takes x+5 minutes

As per the question,

1/x + 1/(x+5) = 1/6

2x + 5 = x(x+5) 1/6

12x + 30 = x² + 5x

x2 - 7x - 30 = 0

(x+3)(x-10) = 0

So x = 10 

Time taken by B is 10 + 5 = 15 minutes

**∴ The correct option is 4**
